mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_ticket (ticket_no, user_id, shop_id, order_id, order_no, order_item_id, product_id, sku_id, type, reason_type, description, status) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{type}, #{reasonType}, #{description}, #{status})
INSERT INTO after_sale_attachment (ticket_id, user_id, url, object_key, file_name, file_size) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{userId}, #{url}, #{objectKey}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize})
INSERT INTO after_sale_message (ticket_id, sender_id, sender_type, content) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{senderId}, #{senderType}, #{content})

INSERT INTO after_sale_operation_log (ticket_id, operator_id, operator_type, operation, before_status, after_status, reason) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorType}, #{operation}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_no AS ticketNo, user_id AS userId, shop_id AS shopId, order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, order_item_id AS orderItemId, product_id AS productId, sku_id AS skuId, type, reason_type AS reasonType, description, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, final_result AS finalResult, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, close_time AS closeTime FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE ticket_no = #{ticketNo} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, ticket_no AS ticketNo, user_id AS userId, shop_id AS shopId, order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, order_item_id AS orderItemId, product_id AS productId, sku_id AS skuId, type, reason_type AS reasonType, description, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, final_result AS finalResult, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, close_time AS closeTime FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE ticket_no = #{ticketNo} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, ticket_no AS ticketNo, user_id AS userId, shop_id AS shopId, order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, order_item_id AS orderItemId, product_id AS productId, sku_id AS skuId, type, reason_type AS reasonType, description, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, final_result AS finalResult, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, close_time AS closeTime FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.sql: id, ticket_no AS ticketNo, user_id AS userId, shop_id AS shopId, order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, order_item_id AS orderItemId, product_id AS productId, sku_id AS skuId, type, reason_type AS reasonType, description, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, final_result AS finalResult, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, close_time AS closeTime
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM after_sale_ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}

SELECT id, ticket_id AS ticketId, user_id AS userId, url, object_key AS objectKey, file_name AS fileName, file_size AS fileSize, create_time AS createTime FROM after_sale_attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, ticket_id AS ticketId, sender_id AS senderId, sender_type AS senderType, content, create_time AS createTime FROM after_sale_message WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, ticket_id AS ticketId, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_type AS operatorType, operation, before_status AS beforeStatus, after_status AS afterStatus, reason, create_time AS createTime FROM after_sale_operation_log WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sale_ticket SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, final_result = #{finalResult}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , close_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
